title: Enumerate the original two-thread class and instance monitor schedules
description: Explore all sequentially consistent application-bytecode interleavings of the three frozen MonitorIdentity callers, one successful platform-thread start and uninterrupted join. Record both observable orders for mixed locks and the protected reads for class-matched locks. Reconstruct all four outcomes on the original JVM, and vary only the treatment of the static synchronized modifier as a comparator control.
expected: Every reachable state can progress to termination, class-matched callers return true, mixed callers return both answers, and the original JVM replays each outcome. Ignoring static synchronization must admit the additional false outcome.

steps.name: Explore original bytecode and replay both monitor orders
